about: FragranceRecs starter catalog (2026-10-23): popular current perfumes and colognes, designer and niche, one entry per line and concentration (Sauvage Eau de Toilette, Eau de Parfum, Parfum, Elixir and Extrait are five fragrances). Every value was read on 2026-10-23 from the page in sources; anything that page does not state is blank. Designer lines: Ulta Beauty product pages (breadcrumb Men/Cologne, Women/Perfume or Unisex for 'For'; sizes; Key Notes; Fragrance Family) or, where Ulta does not carry the concentration, Perfumania's product pages (gender, type, sizes, top/middle/base notes). Creed, Parfums de Marly, Lattafa and Armaf: the makers' own shops (who it is sold for, concentration, sizes, notes, and Creed's fragrance family); where the maker's page did not give the concentration (several Lattafa pages), Perfumania's page for the same fragrance is the second source and only the concentration comes from it. Concentration is the source's own wording: 'Elixir' read only out of a name (Le Male Elixir, Sauvage Elixir) is left blank, and so is 'For' where the retailer's gender contradicts how the line is sold (Le Labo, Byredo, Oud Wood, CK One, Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait). Columns: shape = For, balance = concentration, weight = bottle sizes, core = notes, surface = fragrance family. No model years. Samples, minis, gift sets, refills and body products are left out.
